title: The Fastest $500K I’ve Ever Made (OST Collapse)

observed_trades.setup: Short of a suspected wash-traded China small cap expected to collapse 80-90% like CGTL/JYD; took a small starter.
observed_trades.quote: you know, I had taken a starter at um 9:07.
observed_trades.notes: Starter appears to be on the collapse day (the 26th) before the open; date not pinned in the sentence.

observed_trades.setup: Shorted again on the ramp back up after the pre-open dump, building to a full position.
observed_trades.entry_basis: re-short after the low-volume ramp back up
observed_trades.quote: is where I started to short this thing again. Um, and I finally got myself to my full position with my stop at high of day
observed_trades.notes: Same day as the halt-down ('I'm short uh OST on the 26th' at 04:56).

observed_trades.setup: Covered a little under half after the halt reopened, at about 70 cents.
observed_trades.quote: Okay, I got some filled. Oh, baby, I got 70s filled.
observed_trades.notes: Live clip on the collapse day (the 26th).

observed_trades.setup: Covered the rest at 83 cents for a roughly $500K winner on 60,000 shares averaged near $9.11.
observed_trades.quote: I had 60,000 shares um at $911 average effectively for a half million dollar winner on the 26th
observed_trades.notes: Last shares covered at 0.83 ('83s on the last bit. I'm officially gone.' 09:18); '$911' = $9.11 average short price.
